resources.string: The trip you follow, updated live: quiet, without sound or vibration. Also when a trip started on the watch can be followed here.
When you have to act: getting off, a changed platform, a connection that no longer works and the time to leave for a planned trip. With sound and vibration.
Faster ways during a followed trip. Shown quietly, without sound.
The wake-up alarm before getting off a long ride: rings like an alarm clock, full screen.
New disruptions on the routes you watch.
